car.name: 2018 Kestrel 660
car.description: Original fictional salvage roadster with factory 2018 Honda S660 6MT powertrain and dimensions as its reference. Simulation-only values are estimates, not manufacturer measurements.

catalogProvenance.artwork: Original fictional logo-free design. Not an OEM replica or copied racing-game asset.

fields: tuning.powerHp (47 kW converted to mechanical hp)

estimates: All simulation fields not explicitly attributed above are inherited RWD-preset baselines or provisional gameplay estimates, including track widths, tire size/pressure, weight distribution, suspension, braking, aero, drag, redline/idle, performance targets, and engine torque-curve shape.
Real car has staggered tires; common editor size is provisional.
Original salvage body collider profile and wheel placement require visual/physics QA; not certified manufacturer geometry.
Collider overhangs, CG height, track, wheel radius and body sections scaled explicitly for kei dimensions; front/rear axle distances derived from wheelbase and estimated 45% front weight.
Torque curve anchors at 2600 and 6000 rpm sourced/derived; remaining samples are estimates. Editor rounds lb-ft to integers, approximately 77 lb-ft and 63 hp.

Wheel-well centers/radii measured manually from original sprite sheet; per-angle graphical scale/placement calibrated to production rear-axle anchored wheel rig. These are visual estimates, not changes to physical dimensions; browser review required.

Diagonal sprite visual envelope uses 45-degree blend of principal-view widths; per-axle graphic offsets accommodate differing authored perspective without altering physics or magnifying diagonal bodies.
